items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I played with Edgar for a while this was at the dream room on Boyfriend Street

ctx.x: did you play with Edgar was that who were you next

I got I got with Edgar Blanchett I stayed with Edgar for I don't know how I had a little book that's what I'm saying something like this blue book okay I got a book of all the things on the road Lloyd came to my house with some guy and most of the pictures that I have I still have a few other pictures of Slim but the pictures that I had he took a few of them and he was supposed to send me an itinerary of all yeah the guy I don't know where he got it okay he was gonna get an itinerary of where we played when we…
